reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is bounded agent context management with durable session recall, replacing the default transcript loop while retaining the harness tools and persistence.

summaries.zh: 通过有界上下文切片、会话记录和按需回溯，替换 DeepSeek Harness 的默认对话循环。
summaries.en: Replaces the default DeepSeek Harness transcript loop with bounded context slices, durable session records, and on-demand turn recall.

capabilities: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness agent loop with a bounded per-turn context slice
Maintains an append-only session tape with provenance and hash metadata
Provides searchable and verbatim recall of archived turns
Persists session content in the harness session log
